purpose: Everything below inherits from this. Getting it wrong makes the rest of the work the wrong work.

items.task: List every location people work from, including homes
items.evidence: Written list of sites and home-working arrangements

items.task: List every device that can reach organisational data, including personally owned ones
items.evidence: Device inventory with owner and type

items.task: List every cloud service in use, including services adopted by one team
Write down what is in scope, what is excluded, and the reason for each exclusion

purpose: What sits between your systems and the internet, and who decided each gap in it.

items.task: Identify every internet-facing device and cloud boundary
Confirm default administrative passwords have been changed
Record the business reason for each inbound rule
items.evidence: Firewall rule list with justification and approver

items.task: Confirm a firewall is active on devices used outside the office

purpose: Devices and software set up deliberately rather than left at whatever the vendor shipped.

items.task: Remove or disable user accounts that are no longer needed
Remove or disable software that is not needed
items.evidence: Installed software list per device type

items.task: Confirm no default credentials remain anywhere in scope
Confirm devices lock automatically when unattended

purpose: Who can reach what, who approved it, and what happens when someone leaves.

items.task: Produce a user list showing role and whether the account is administrative
Confirm administrative accounts are approved and used only for administrative tasks
Confirm the leaver process removes access, with a recent example
items.evidence: Leaver process document and one completed instance

items.task: Per cloud service, record whether MFA is available and whether it is on for all users
items.evidence: Service-by-service MFA table with date and who checked

purpose: One of three approaches per device type, and proof it is actually running.

items.task: Record which approach applies to each device type: anti-malware, allow-listing or sandboxing
Confirm protection is active and updating
Confirm how personally owned devices in scope are covered
items.evidence: BYOD arrangement, or evidence the restriction is enforced

purpose: Supported software, patched inside the window. The support half fails quietly.

items.task: Produce a software inventory recording vendor support status and end-of-life dates
Confirm nothing in scope is past vendor end of life
Confirm critical and high-risk updates are applied within 14 days of release
Keep one sample patch record showing the window was met

purpose: The pass that catches answers describing last year's organisation.

items.task: Confirm every answer describes the arrangement as it is today
items.evidence: Reviewer name and date against each control area

items.task: Confirm every claim has a named owner and evidence behind it
Confirm you are working from the current Danzell question set and v3.3 requirements
items.evidence: Note of the question set in use

items.task: Choose a Certification Body and confirm the fee band for your headcount
